oneLineCopy: Your website exists — and stays current without you touching it.

hero.headlineSerifLead: Website and landing pages built from what you already say — and kept alive by your Aven instead of your weekend.

founderScenario.story: "Send me your website" — and Samuel sends a link he has been meaning to rework for fourteen months. The prices are wrong, the offer goes by another name, and the best argument for it sits in a voice note nobody but him has ever heard.

benefits: Your site is built from your real words, not from a template
Landing pages for new offers in minutes instead of weekends
Prices and content stay current because your Aven pulls them from one source
Fast, clean and readable on any device — no page-builder ballast
The site is yours: content and code come with you if you leave
howSteps: You tell your Aven what you offer and who it's for
It builds structure, copy and pages from that — in the voice you agree on
You read it back and release it; changes you say instead of click
Offer changed? The site follows without you opening it

whatMechanics.magic: Structure draft → copy in your brand voice → static site → publish → continuous updates from one source
whatMechanics.output: A hosted website · a landing page per offer · content that doesn't go stale

letterFromPublisher: Samuel put off his own website for fourteen months — not because he didn't know what it should say, but because too many steps sat between knowing and publishing. I took the steps. He talks, I build, he reads it back. This page came about exactly that way.
